commands.source_checks: Six canonical source SHA256 pins plus literal matrix equality.

commands.scope: Both normal and optimized self-contained replays match RESULT.json byte-for-byte, empty PATH, read-only package, fresh unused pycache path; two JSON codec roundtrips, history CLI, three CLI rejections.
Five semantic mutations rejected with explicit ValueError in both normal and optimized modes on private copies.

not_run: Full physical caller, native/compiler, or selected-result replay
Shared registered research-package CI (this standalone package is not registered)

publication_checks.result_receipt: External submission receipt, checked after creating the publication commit.
publication_checks.scientific_replay: Existing executable and fixture hashes are unchanged; no historical suites rerun for metadata-only submission edits.
publication_checks.scope: Exact raw Git blob comparison for every published package file, source-pin blob/SHA256 checks, and base ancestry. Standalone package has no VERIFY.json; the shared registered-package preflight does not apply.

scientific_limits: Finite source identities and the written proof establish the asserted all-input result; probes are calibration rather than independent review.
Large fibers and 13^(8Nt) states are counted by the proof, not exhaustively enumerated.
Positive-refinement/side-information volume bounds are necessary and not asserted sharp.
Repeated sharp history requires the unbounded lattice or a sufficiently large finite range.
Source kernel is destructive; the new mathematical codec has no reversible or paid arithmetic/tape implementation.
